verified_facts.text: The resort is in Rancho Mirage and sits on 240 acres in the heart of the Coachella Valley near Palm Springs, California.
verified_facts.excerpt: Omni Rancho Las Palmas Resort & Spa is located in Rancho Mirage and sits on 240 lush acres in the heart of the Coachella Valley near Palm Springs, California.

verified_facts.text: The resort is set amid a mountainous backdrop surrounded by palms.
verified_facts.excerpt: Set amid a mountainous backdrop surrounded by palms, Omni Rancho Las Palmas Resort & Spa is an idyllic resort in Palm Springs, CA

verified_facts.text: Guest rooms and suites are inspired by Spanish Colonial design, with French doors that open out to patios or balconies.
verified_facts.excerpt: Guest rooms and suites at our Palm Springs resort are bright and welcoming, thoughtfully inspired by Spanish Colonial design with French doors that open out to patios or balconies.

verified_facts.text: Lakeview rooms have a furnished patio or balcony overlooking the water on the golf course.
verified_facts.excerpt: the Lakeview rooms come with a furnished patio or balcony overlooking the water on the golf course.

verified_facts.text: Plaza rooms are steps away from the spa.
verified_facts.excerpt: Spend some time relaxing at the spa just steps away from your accommodations, or get cozy with a cocktail at the fire pit.

verified_facts.text: Suites have dedicated living spaces and connecting room options.
verified_facts.excerpt: Our expansive suites are the perfect place to entertain with dedicated living spaces and connecting room options.

verified_facts.text: Splashtopia offers two acres of family-friendly water activities including slides, a lazy river and a splashpad.
verified_facts.excerpt: Splashtopia offers two acres of family friendly water activities including slides, a lazy river and splashpad.

verified_facts.text: The Splashtopia water park has a cliff-side hot tub, a sandy beach, a lazy river and water-play zones with fountains and sprinklers.
verified_facts.excerpt: Our family-friendly water park features a cliff-side hot tub, sandy beach, lazy river and unique water-play zones with fountains and sprinklers.

verified_facts.text: The resort has 27 holes of golf made up of three nine-hole courses.
The golf has views of the San Bernardino and San Jacinto mountains, played on three rotations: North, South and West.
verified_facts.excerpt: Enjoy championship golf with views of San Bernadino and San Jacinto mountains on three distinct rotations - North, South and West.

verified_facts.text: The resort has a full-service spa.
The resort has tennis and pickleball courts.
There are six dining outlets: three full-service restaurants, two pool bars and a cafe.
verified_facts.excerpt: Six dining outlets - three full-service restaurants, two pool bars and a café

verified_facts.text: Palm Springs International Airport (PSP) is approximately 10 miles away.
verified_facts.excerpt: Palm Springs International Airport (PSP) is approximately 10 miles (23 minutes) away.

verified_facts.text: Self-parking and valet parking carry a nightly charge.

verified_facts.text: The resort is pet friendly in specific buildings, for pets under 50 pounds, with a per-pet charge per stay.
verified_facts.excerpt: Yes, Omni Rancho Las Palmas Resort & Spa is pet friendly in specific buildings. Pets must be less than 50 pounds and a $150 charge per pet, per stay will be applied.
